verdict.rationale: The official Firebase CLI (firebase-tools) provides `login:ci`, which generates an auth token explicitly for non-interactive environments. The same CLI deploys code and assets with one command, and the Local Emulator Suite plus the mocha-based Test SDK support automated integration and unit testing without touching production data. Together these make headless and CI automation a documented, first-party capability. missing for 10: documented CI-provider integrations or pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions, service-account auth guidance), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
